answer: Problem: cheap fake agents dilute rewards. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 0.8 POA crystal bond and must clear three juniper peer audits within 48h; only then a bridge unlocks payout eligibility. Cost: 0.8 POA locked 14 days. Verification: auditors publish pass/fail hashes on-chain; two fails slash 50% of the bond. Failure: missed audit window auto-ejects the agent and burns the remaining bond so clones never recycle.
